skill.name: wechat-management
skill.description: Use WeChatMCP to review WeChat chat context, draft short replies, and send messages with confirmation.
skill.summary: Guide safe WeChat message review, reply drafting, and sending through WeChatMCP.
skill.author: 7Sageer, Claude

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backtick detections are false positives caused by inline code spans, not shell execution. The hardcoded URL is an example message link, and the entropy heuristic is explained by readable multilingual Markdown. A medium semantic risk remains because the skill supports external WeChat messaging and style imitation.

remediation.issue: External WeChat messages can affect real contacts.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval of the recipient, exact message text, and final send action before sending.
Limit tone adaptation to user-approved wording and avoid claims of identity, authority, or consent not provided by the user.

remediation.issue: WeChat screenshots can expose private chat data.
remediation.suggestion: Review only the user-requested chat and redact unnecessary personal or financial details in summaries.

semantic_findings.title: External Messaging and Style-Imitation Risk
semantic_findings.description: The skill is intended to send WeChat messages and tells the assistant to mimic historical message style. This could be misused for unauthorized contact or impersonation if confirmation is not enforced.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The messaging capability and style imitation instruction are explicit. The file also includes confirmation rules, so the risk is real but mitigated.

content.value_statement: WeChat replies can be hard to draft safely when context changes quickly. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to review chat state, draft concise replies, and confirm sends through WeChatMCP.
actual_capabilities: Works with the WeChatMCP server for WeChat-related actions.
Guides screenshot checks before acting on the current chat state.
Sets reply style rules for short messages, emoji use, and tone adaptation.
Requires confirmation of recipient and content before sending messages.
Requests extra confirmation for sensitive or financial information.
Recommends web search before answering uncertain current information.
limitations: Requires the WeChatMCP server and cannot access WeChat by itself.
Provides workflow guidance, not a complete WeChat automation client.
Does not include authentication, contact management, or scheduling features.
Message sending can affect real contacts and needs user approval.

use_cases.title: Reply to work group messages
use_cases.description: Review the current chat state and draft concise replies for professional WeChat groups.

use_cases.title: Prepare personal chat responses
use_cases.description: Create short, natural replies that match the context before asking for send approval.

use_cases.title: Handle uncertain topics
use_cases.description: Check current facts with web search before drafting a WeChat response about news or products.

prompt_templates.title: Check the chat state
prompt_templates.prompt: Use WeChatMCP to inspect the current WeChat screen. Summarize the active chat and tell me whether it is safe to reply.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a short reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft two short WeChat replies for the active chat. Keep each message under 30 Chinese characters and wait for my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Confirm before sending
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a reply for this contact, show the exact recipient and message text, and ask me before sending through WeChatMCP.

prompt_templates.title: Verify and respond
prompt_templates.prompt: For this uncertain product or news topic, search the web first, then draft a concise WeChat reply with the verified facts.

output_examples.input: Draft a reply to a work group asking whether the report is ready.
output_examples.output: Suggested reply: The report is ready. I will send it after one more check. Please confirm the recipient before sending.

output_examples.input: Reply to a friend who recommended a show.
output_examples.output: Suggested replies: Sounds interesting, I will check it later. The idea looks creative. I can send either message after approval.

output_examples.input: A contact asks about a current product release date.
output_examples.output: I will verify the date with web search first, then draft a short reply and ask before sending.

best_practices: Confirm the recipient and exact message text before every send.
Keep replies short and split complex ideas into two or three messages.
Use web search for current facts before answering time-sensitive questions.
anti_patterns: Sending messages without explicit user approval.
Opening public accounts or unrelated non-chat information.
Using style imitation to impersonate someone or hide uncertainty.

faq.question: Does this skill work without WeChatMCP?
faq.answer: No. It is only guidance for use with the WeChatMCP server.

faq.question: Can it send messages automatically?
faq.answer: It should not send automatically. The skill requires confirmation of recipient and content before sending.

faq.question: Can it read every part of WeChat?
faq.answer: No. The instructions limit review to chat context and discourage viewing unrelated public accounts.

faq.question: How does it handle sensitive information?
faq.answer: It asks for secondary confirmation when messages involve sensitive or financial information.

faq.question: Can it answer current news questions?
faq.answer: Yes, but it should use web search first when information may be current or uncertain.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
